verdict: A correct, idiomatic destructive-confirm overlay built only from the real Baklava bl-dialog and bl-button components (open/critical/caption + kind=danger and variant=secondary, valid primary-action/secondary-action slots), faithfully mirroring Ant Design's Modal.confirm intent (blocking overlay, red confirm, grey cancel) with zero hallucinated tags. The only real weaknesses are accessibility-related: no aria-describedby linking the explanatory body to the dialog, and autofocus placed on the destructive Delete button, which is a keyboard-safety risk (Enter on focus triggers deletion).
